# Manage cookies consent and marketing preferences

## Overview

When deploying tracking or sending communications that require a reviewed permission and preference process. A tested preference system whose actual behavior matches the approved notices and consent rules.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Inventory tracking and messaging purposes

agent-runnable


List scripts, cookies, device identifiers, audiences and communication channels. Record who supplies each component and what data it collects before assuming a banner controls all processing.

- Sources: [GOV.UK data protection and your business](https://www.gov.uk/data-protection-your-business)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Determine the applicable permission model

human · human approval required


Privacy and marketing reviewers assess the actual jurisdictions, audience, purposes and channels. Document required consent, permitted alternatives and opt-out handling without reusing one market's rules globally.

- Sources: [GOV.UK data protection and your business](https://www.gov.uk/data-protection-your-business)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Configure approved notices and preference controls

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


Authorized operators implement the reviewed choices, suppression lists and tracking configuration. Avoid loading blocked components before the approved permission and retain the configuration version.

- Sources: [GOV.UK data protection and your business](https://www.gov.uk/data-protection-your-business)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Test consent withdrawal and preference propagation

agent-runnable


Exercise first visit, acceptance, refusal, withdrawal and returning-user cases. Verify downstream analytics and messaging respect the recorded choices and identify vendors that do not receive updates.

- Sources: [GOV.UK data protection and your business](https://www.gov.uk/data-protection-your-business)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Approve release and monitor changes

human · human approval required


The accountable owners review test evidence and unresolved exceptions before launch. Reassess new scripts, channels or purposes and keep support and privacy-request routes available.

- Verify: A tested preference system whose actual behavior matches the approved notices and consent rules.
- Sources: [GOV.UK data protection and your business](https://www.gov.uk/data-protection-your-business)
